design: Inject each of six typed basis ports once in each direction; measure both quadratures in all six output ports against one common local oscillator.
acceptance: Both complex 6x6 maps are reconstructed at full real rank; J_reverse*J_forward=I; J_forward^dagger*J_forward=I in the frozen source metric; no typed port or environment output is omitted.
intensity_only_lower_bound: At least 36 input preparations per direction recover row Gram data using basis, pair-sum, and pair-quarter-turn probes, but leave output-row phases unsewn without a common coherent reference.
authority_boundary: Six is a lower bound obtained by assigning one scalar coordinate to each currently required typed channel. Source multiplicities may increase it. Tomography measures a proposed sewing and does not derive it.
